FOREST &RBURN!! Green Man want to stop fire but can’t smash??? HELP!!!
Yo man!! Remember my &Gisland? Everybody's lovin' it! But I keep gettin' &Ounwanted &Ovisitors... I need some &Rbig &Rdefense &Rsystem, ya dig? A &Phuge &Pboat would do!

Hey, you know what cop cars can’t do? Fly. I need you to test this thing before I set foot in it though. I’m not still alive because I’m reckless, you know…
Arrrr, matey, swab the decks! That’s my pirate voice, did you like it? Anyway, let’s talk business. I’m filming Pirates of the Mediterranean and need some pirate ships! Can you do it?

Ey YO! I need some tiny lil babby boats, ya dig? It’s fo’ Swag Island visitors. Now that they all there, they gotta buy my boats to leave, dawg. You aint got no IDEA how much Washington I’m gonna make!
In my next music video I’ll be singing, but mostly dancing, in a cement mixer in space! Zero grav is the new thing, and cement will be the secret sauce! Just imagine the views! Make it happen!

People rely on me to save them from Pokerface, but what have I gotten in return? I’d like to just sail away on an endless holiday. Can you build me my dreamboat? Hm, are you going to finish that sandwich?
Eyyeeeeyyy! Gringo! You may have beaten me, my brother, my sister, my grandmother, my… You get the point! But that was child’s play! You ever DRIFTED before, boy? This is the REAL deal.
Oh man, it’s actually HAPPENED! Monkeys have invaded! I’m the most important person, so they must be after me, right?! What’s a monkey’s weakness? Flying tanks! Make me some! Go, hurry, quick!
On the HONOR of my MUSTACHE, I will beat you this time! You will kiss the asphalt on my wheels!
MCBEEEEEEF! Harrr hahaha! GRRR, you build? ZFC Beef good! Eaaaat ZFC! Grrr… ha!
This is unacceptable! I’m a spy without a self-driving car. And now that intelligent monkeys are invading, I really need one to do cool spy stuff! Can you help me?

It’s been a weird day! Monkeys are invading, I saw Mr. Coffee flying around in a tank, and… I think a hamburger passed me on the highway earlier. I think I should go away for a bit. Make me something fast, will ya?

Yeah, I’m back. I saw explosions in the city from out at sea. Super-intelligent monkeys, eh? I may have worn these socks for a week, but I’m still CatMan! Build me whatever you got, I’m going after them!
